_help: Duplicate the objects in 'questions' below to add more. Delete this _help block before uploading if you like - it's ignored either way. Upload this whole file in the Admin > Bulk Add Questions panel, or POST it as-is to /api/admin/questions/bulk.

_fieldNotes.category: Must exactly match one of _validCategories above (case-insensitive).
_fieldNotes.question: The question text.
_fieldNotes.correctIndex: 0-based index into options for the correct answer (0, 1, 2, or 3).
_fieldNotes.difficulty: One of: easy, medium, hard. Defaults to easy if omitted.
_fieldNotes.funFact: Optional - shown to the player after they answer.
_fieldNotes.sourceLink: Optional - URL backing the answer, for fact-checking.
_fieldNotes.subtopic: Optional - finer-grained label within the category.
_fieldNotes.tags: Optional array of free-form tag strings.
_fieldNotes.yearReleased: Optional integer, e.g. for a game/movie/show release year.
